auditor_note: This is the 18th operational resume dispatch to an already-completed fractal-map lane. The supervisor dispatch mechanism should implement a pre-dispatch guard that reads state/<lane>.json and skips dispatch when cycle_status=COMPLETED and continue_recommended=false. All validated artifacts and metrics remain unchanged from prior audit-ready runs. The v5 factory direction adds specific metric references (purity=0.9634 from hierarchical_leiden flat labels, zoom_coherence +7.68% from evaluation baseline) and legal-distance integration context, but the core fractal-map deliverable — the validated multi-resolution hierarchical Leiden map with product integration artifacts — is complete and unchanged.
